name: 头部姿态估计分析
description: 检测3D头部姿态轨迹中的不一致性，表明面部操纵。
useCase: Exposing 深度伪造s through unnatural head pose transitions and geometric 不一致
mechanism: Estimates 3D head orientation (pitch, yaw, roll) 跨 frames and 分析 the trajectory smoothness. Deepfake 换脸s often produce head poses that are inconsistent 之间 the source and target face, creating detectable discontinuities in the pose trajectory.
source: Yang, X. et al. (2019) - Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses, ICASSP
algorithm: 3D Head Pose Estimation (PnP) + Trajectory Smoothness Analysis + Source-Target Consistency
parameters: Landmarks: 68-point model, Pose estimation: EPnP algorithm, Smoothness: Savitzky-Golay filter
